nodes.label: Domain-Oriented Frontend Architecture
nodes.rationale: src/lib is organized by what a file is about, not what it is. Six domains each own components, state, invokers, contracts, utilities and tests, so reading one feature means opening one directory instead of five.

nodes.label: One-Way Domain Dependency Rule
nodes.rationale: statistics | tree | distributions -> slices -> filters -> event-log, plus distributions -> tree. Nothing points back up, so a dependency cycle cannot form and each domain can be read bottom-up.

nodes.label: SPA Mode (no SSR)
nodes.rationale: Tauri has no Node server, so +layout.ts sets ssr = false and adapter-static uses fallback index.html; the whole app is client-rendered and routes resolve in the browser after load.

nodes.label: One Invoker File Per Tauri Command
nodes.rationale: Each Tauri command gets one file in <domain>/invokers/ named after it, so invoker -> contract -> Rust command is one-to-one; components call the invoker rather than invoke() directly.

nodes.label: Request/Response Type Prefix Convention
nodes.rationale: Types at a call boundary carry a direction prefix (Response*/Request*) so the prefix marks what an invoker hands over directly; nested types stay unprefixed.

nodes.label: Filter Kind Extension Point
nodes.rationale: A new filter kind is one file in filters/kind/ plus two lines in filter.ts, plus one editor file and one else-if branch. Mirrors src-tauri/src/filters/ so both sides grow the same way.

nodes.label: Slice Two Measurement Caches
nodes.rationale: Results are cached as in-memory impacts and persisted stats/statsKey, both keyed by chainKey(effectiveChain(slice)); anything showing a case count must compare that key or an edited chain leaves stale numbers on screen.

nodes.label: Deep Imports, No Barrel Files
nodes.rationale: Importing from the exact module path rather than a domain index keeps every dependency visible in the import line.

nodes.label: CLI-Managed shadcn UI Directory
nodes.rationale: src/lib/components/ui/ is treated as generated: never hand-edited, re-run the shadcn-svelte add/update CLI instead. $lib/utils.ts and $lib/hooks/ stay put because components.json pins those aliases.

nodes.label: Thin Routes Convention
nodes.rationale: Routes handle URL structure and page composition only. Four routes (distributions, new, filters, tree) are still fat and are a known deferred cleanup.
